title: Mystic Portal Sorceress
description: A woman in a flowing cosmic gown stands in a shallow pool of water during a rainstorm, her arms outstretched as she looks upward. Behind her, an ornate stone archway frames an open glowing book that reveals a swirling galaxy portal with stars and light emanating from it.
prompt: A mystical woman with long dark hair wearing a flowing iridescent gown stands in a shallow reflective pool during a rainstorm, arms outstretched and head tilted upward in awe. An ornate ancient stone archway behind her frames an open magical book floating in the air that reveals a swirling galaxy and stars within its pages, with glowing particles, white flowers, and ethereal smoke surrounding her, dramatic fantasy scene with cosmic elements
